what: Buyer made a purchase via Lemon Squeezy during which their email address was saved incorrectly due to a simple typo; describes the overall experience as "simply disappointing in its sheer inefficiency" and calls the core problem trivial.
verbatim_snippet: "The experience I had with Lemon Squeezy was simply disappointing in its sheer inefficiency. The core problem was trivial: During a purchase via the platform, my email address was saved incorrectly due to a simple typo."
